classes.name: EssUserRole
classes.description: Represents a user role specific to Employee Self-Service (ESS) functionalities in OrangeHRM, providing methods for accessing various performance-related entities based on user permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves accessible entity IDs based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Fetches self-review IDs for the employee with optional status filtering.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerIdsForESS
methods.description: Gets performance tracker IDs associated with the authenticated employee.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerLogIdsForESS
methods.description: Gets performance tracker log IDs associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of quick launch items available for ESS users.
